discription: A bright pulse-width modulation lead synth with vibrato.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, width=0.5, vibratoRate=5, vibratoDepth=0.01;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var vibrato = SinOsc.kr(vibratoRate) * vibratoDepth;    var modulatedFreq = freq * (1 + vibrato);    sig = Pulse.ar(modulatedFreq, width) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
